intro.text: Version 2026-09-29. These Terms govern your use of Tailmance. Any country- or region-specific terms shown to you form part of these Terms. Account holders must be at least 18 years old.

blocks.text: Tailmance helps cat and dog owners create pet profiles and use discovery and social features. Keep account information accurate, protect account security, and do not transfer your account. Tailmance is not a veterinary, medical, emergency, pet-sale, or payment-intermediation service.

You must be at least 18 to create an account. Where applicable law or store rules require additional age assurance, access may require further verification. A false age statement may result in restricted or terminated access.

Upload only pet, photo, health, and profile information you are authorized to use and share. Do not knowingly misrepresent vaccination, health, breed, age, sex, ownership, or verification information, and do not upload unnecessary personal or sensitive data about others.

You retain your rights in content you upload. You grant Tailmance a worldwide, non-exclusive license limited to operating, storing, displaying, transmitting, securing, and moderating that content as needed to provide the service. Ownership does not transfer to Tailmance.

Animal abuse, harassment, threats, hate, child sexual abuse material, fraud, illegal goods or services, unauthorized personal or intimate data, false health or verification information, intellectual-property infringement, impersonation, bypassing security or moderation, and facilitating unlawful activity are prohibited. The Community Guidelines provide further detail.

sections.heading: 6. Pet sales, commercial breeding and mating

blocks.text: Tailmance is not a pet marketplace, pet-sales platform, or breeder marketplace. It may not be used to arrange animal prices, deposits, sales, delivery, commercial breeder customer acquisition, unlawful breeding, or animal trafficking. Mating is disabled by default and may be enabled only where Tailmance expressly activates it and applicable law and animal-welfare rules permit it. The service also may not be used to offer, request, broker, or arrange adoption, rehoming, or transfer of ownership of a pet.

Tailmance may restrict content visibility or account access for safety, Terms, Community Guidelines, or legal reasons. Where appropriate, users receive reasons and an available appeal route. A successful appeal does not cancel a separate valid restriction affecting the same content or account.

Tailmance does not provide veterinary care, medical diagnosis, or emergency services. Vaccination, health, or verification records in the app do not replace professional veterinary assessment. Seek an appropriate veterinarian, emergency service, or authority when needed.

AI-assisted health document checks. Tailmance may use AI-assisted text recognition to review the health record that you upload for your pet. The check only reads what the document says: it does not identify a pet’s breed, does not examine or diagnose the animal, and is not a veterinary certification. If the document is complete and consistent (it shows a microchip number, the vaccinations and the internal and external parasite treatments, with no errors or conflicting details), the check may mark it as verified. Incomplete, unclear or inconsistent documents are not verified automatically and may be reviewed by a person. AI can make mistakes and may miss errors or misread a document, so please check important information yourself. A verified label is not a guarantee of an animal’s health or vaccination status and is not a final, binding or legally valid decision. Rely on a licensed veterinarian for health decisions and do not delay care because of a result shown in the app.

Premium is optional and Standard use remains available without a subscription. Unless the store states otherwise, Premium renews automatically. The binding price, currency, tax, period, trial, and promotion terms are shown by the App Store or Google Play. Manage and cancel through the relevant store. Deleting your Tailmance account does not automatically cancel a store subscription.

The Privacy Policy and applicable local privacy supplements explain data processing. Marketing push consent is separate and optional. If age assurance uses identity, facial, biometric, or other sensitive data, the relevant additional privacy information and rights must be presented separately.

You may permanently delete your account and may use the web deletion route if you cannot access the app. Tailmance may apply proportionate restrictions for Terms, safety, or legal violations and, where applicable, provide reasons and appeal rights. Deletion does not require immediate erasure of limited records that law requires us to retain for security, disputes, lawful requests, or accounting.

Upload only content you are entitled to share. Rights holders may use the Intellectual Property Notice process. Country-specific notice, counter-notice, and restoration rights remain applicable where required.

Features may change, be suspended, or be unavailable in a country for security, law, store-policy, or product reasons. Tailmance does not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free access, but mandatory consumer rights and obligations for paid services remain unaffected.

Nothing in these Terms removes consumer, data-protection, accessibility, or other rights that applicable law does not allow you to waive. Disclaimers and liability limitations apply only to the extent permitted by law.

Applicable law, mandatory consumer forum, alternative dispute resolution, courts, regulator access, and other local rights may vary according to where you habitually reside or where the service is offered. Country- or region-specific supplements complete these Terms, and mandatory local rights are preserved.

When binding Terms or applicable local supplements materially change, Tailmance will provide notice or request renewed acceptance where required. Acceptance from an old country, region, or document-language context does not automatically carry over to a new context.

Use the Support and Contact page for support, safety, privacy, and other requests. Where applicable law requires operator, representative, regulator, or consumer-contact information, it will be included in the relevant local supplement.

intro.text: Version 2026-09-29. Data controller: Yekta Özel. This Policy explains how Tailmance processes personal data. Country- or region-specific privacy supplements shown to you apply together with it. This Policy is not marketing consent.

blocks.text: We may process account and session data, including your email address and sign-in identifiers; security, device, network, IP and push-token data; crash and performance diagnostics; pet profiles, photos, posts, stories and private messages between matched pets; approximate discovery location; health, vaccination and verification records you choose to upload; owner identity-verification and age-assurance results where these features are used; subscription status and store transaction references; reports, blocks, moderation and appeals; notification and marketing preferences; and records proving which legal context and documents were shown to you.

We obtain data directly from you, your device and app use, content you upload, safety and moderation processes, the App Store or Google Play, authorized service providers, and in limited cases other users' reports or content.

We process data to provide accounts and social features, discovery and matching, messaging and notifications, security and fraud prevention, moderation and appeals, subscription verification, user requests, data export and deletion, service reliability, and compliance with applicable law.

Depending on the purpose, data category, and applicable law, processing may rely on contract, legal obligation, legitimate interests, consent, or another lawful basis. Local privacy supplements explain jurisdiction-specific differences.

sections.heading: 5. Notice is separate from marketing consent

blocks.text: A privacy notice informs you about processing; it is not blanket consent. Marketing push notifications require a separate, optional, withdrawable choice and do not authorize email, SMS, phone, or other marketing channels unless separately permitted.

If you allow location access, Tailmance may use device location for discovery. Coordinates are rounded to three decimal places before being sent to the server, stored privately, and are not shown to other users; only approximate distance is displayed. Device and store location signals do not by themselves determine legal jurisdiction.

Pet health and vaccination records may contain sensitive information. Upload only what is necessary and avoid third-party data. Where identity, facial, biometric, or other sensitive information is used for age assurance, additional notice, safeguards, retention limits, provider information, and alternative procedures must be supplied as required.

AI-assisted health document checks. Tailmance may use AI-assisted text recognition to review the health record that you upload for your pet. The check only reads what the document says: it does not identify a pet’s breed, does not examine or diagnose the animal, and is not a veterinary certification. If the document is complete and consistent (it shows a microchip number, the vaccinations and the internal and external parasite treatments, with no errors or conflicting details), the check may mark it as verified. Incomplete, unclear or inconsistent documents are not verified automatically and may be reviewed by a person. AI can make mistakes and may miss errors or misread a document, so please check important information yourself. A verified label is not a guarantee of an animal’s health or vaccination status and is not a final, binding or legally valid decision. Rely on a licensed veterinarian for health decisions and do not delay care because of a result shown in the app.

Data may be shared with authorized infrastructure, security, moderation, messaging, notification, analytics/crash, subscription, and other providers only as needed for the service, and with public authorities where lawfully required. Tailmance does not sell personal data to advertisers.

Where data is transferred internationally, Tailmance must use the mechanism and safeguards required by the applicable jurisdiction and provide any required local notice. Transfer rules may differ by country or region.

Data is retained only for as long as necessary for the purpose or required by law. Different categories have different periods. Account deletion does not require immediate deletion of limited security, fraud, dispute, accounting, or lawful-request records that must be retained.

Tailmance uses technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect data, including access control, encryption in transit, private storage controls, audit records, and abuse prevention. No system can guarantee absolute security.

Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to processing, portability, withdraw consent, challenge certain automated decisions, complain to a regulator, and obtain information about recipients and transfers. Local supplements explain the exact rights and procedures.

Tailmance accounts are for adults aged 18 or older. This product rule does not replace age-assurance, child-safety, reporting, or platform duties that may apply under law or store policies. If Tailmance learns that an ineligible minor created an account, appropriate restriction and deletion steps may be taken.

Automated systems may assist safety, fraud detection, ranking, recommendations, and moderation. Where applicable law requires explanations, human review, objection, or other safeguards for consequential decisions, those rights will be provided.

AI-assisted features. Some features use AI-assisted tools. On supported devices, an on-device model can screen photos for safety before upload. Vaccination and veterinary documents may be checked with AI-assisted text recognition: a pet’s health record that is complete and consistent (microchip, vaccinations, internal and external parasite treatments, no errors) may be marked as verified, and incomplete or unclear documents go to human review. The check only reads the document and never identifies a breed or diagnoses an animal. AI can make mistakes, so please check important information. AI output is only a signal: it is not veterinary advice or a diagnosis and does not by itself decide a consequential outcome for a user. Tailmance does not offer an AI chatbot or AI veterinary diagnosis. A user affected by an AI-assisted result can ask for human review through the in-app appeal process or Support.

Material changes to this Policy or a local supplement will be communicated where required. If a change requires renewed consent or acknowledgement, Tailmance will request it rather than relying on an old choice.

Use the Support and Contact page for privacy requests. Where a local representative, privacy contact, data-protection authority, or other jurisdiction-specific contact is legally required, the relevant local supplement will provide it.

intro.text: These rules apply together with the Terms to keep Tailmance respectful, safe, and focused on animal welfare. Stricter applicable local law takes priority.

blocks.text: Do not abuse or endanger animals, harass, threaten, stalk, exploit, discriminate against, or direct hate at others. Do not encourage unsafe animal handling or conceal material welfare risks.

Child sexual abuse material, sexual exploitation of minors, grooming, solicitation, or content that facilitates such conduct is prohibited. Tailmance may preserve, restrict, and report material where required by law and provides a child-safety contact route.
Do not impersonate people, misrepresent pet ownership, breed, age, sex, health, vaccination, or verification status, or submit fraudulent documents. Verification badges are not veterinary guarantees.

AI can make mistakes, so please check important information. AI-assisted checks only read a pet’s health record: they never identify a breed or diagnose, and may mark a document as verified only when it is complete and consistent (microchip, vaccinations, internal and external parasite treatments). A verified label is not veterinary advice, a certification or a guarantee. Always consult a licensed veterinarian.

Do not share another person's private data, precise location, credentials, medical information, or intimate imagery without authorization. Avoid placing unnecessary third-party personal data in pet records or messages.

sections.heading: 5. Illegal goods, fraud and dangerous conduct

blocks.text: Do not use Tailmance for fraud, unlawful goods or services, weapons or dangerous activity, unauthorized financial schemes, or conduct that facilitates crime or evasion of lawful safety controls.

Tailmance is not a pet-sales or breeder marketplace. Price negotiation, deposits, sale or delivery of animals, commercial breeder lead generation, unlawful breeding, trafficking, or puppy-mill activity are prohibited. The service also may not be used to offer, request, broker, or arrange adoption, rehoming, or transfer of ownership of a pet.

Mating features are disabled by default and may be enabled only after country-specific legal, welfare, age, health, and kinship controls are approved. Users must not use the service to promote harmful or unlawful breeding.
Use in-app reporting and blocking for safety concerns. Tailmance may remove or limit content or accounts and will provide reasons and appeal routes where appropriate and legally required.

Country- and region-specific illegal-content, child-safety, animal-welfare, reporting, preservation, and law-enforcement duties may add to these Guidelines. Tailmance applies the stricter applicable rule where required.

intro.text: Tailmance uses moderation to protect users, animals, the service, and legal compliance. Eligible decisions include an explanation and an appeal route where appropriate.

blocks.text: Tailmance may remove, limit, demote, or restrict content, features, or accounts for Community Guidelines, Terms, safety, fraud, animal-welfare, or legal reasons. Decisions are recorded with a user-visible reason unless disclosure is prohibited for safety or legal reasons.

Where an appeal is available, submit it through the app or stated route within the applicable period. Appeals are reviewed with the decision evidence and may involve human review. A successful appeal does not override a separate valid restriction.

A reversed decision is not treated as complete until the affected product state is actually restored where restoration is appropriate. Conflicting active decisions prevent unsafe automatic restoration.

If account access is restricted, Tailmance provides an appropriate reason and available appeal route unless disclosure is legally or safety restricted. Support and required legal/privacy routes remain available where they must remain accessible.
The internal appeal process does not remove any right you may have to contact a regulator, court, dispute-resolution body, or other competent authority under applicable law.

intro.text: Rights holders and authorized representatives may report content on Tailmance that they believe infringes intellectual-property rights.

blocks.text: Send enough information to identify the protected work or right, locate the reported content, contact you, and show your authority to act. Include a good-faith statement and signature where applicable law requires it.

Tailmance reviews notices under applicable law and safeguards against fraudulent or abusive claims. When content is restricted, the affected user may receive a reason and an available appeal or counter-notice process where appropriate.

Verified repeated infringement may lead to proportionate content or account restrictions. The number of notices alone does not establish infringement; mistaken and abusive notices are also considered.

Where the §512 procedure applies, the U.S.-specific supplement will identify the designated agent and required notice process. This general page does not claim that Tailmance has completed any registration or qualifies for a statutory safe harbor unless the U.S. supplement expressly confirms it.
An intellectual-property notice is not a substitute for emergency or illegal-content reporting. Use in-app reporting, the Safety Center, or Support for those concerns.

intro.text: Tailmance treats accessible use as a core product requirement and aims to support a broad range of users and assistive technologies.

blocks.text: The interface is designed with clear labels, readable text, contrast, scalable text, suitable touch targets, and assistive-technology compatibility. Any higher mandatory accessibility right under applicable law remains unaffected.

If you experience an issue with VoiceOver, TalkBack, larger text, switch access, keyboard navigation, or another accessibility feature, contact us and, where useful, include device, operating-system, and assistive-technology details.

If you cannot use a screen, control, or item of content, or need a reasonable accommodation, contact yektaozel@icloud.com. Do not send personal or sensitive information that is unnecessary to explain the issue.

This page is not an independent accessibility certification or a blanket claim of compliance with every technical or legal standard. It does not limit non-waivable accessibility or consumer rights, and additional local rights may apply.
